ruleDefinitions.name: Lolbin Unregmp2.exe Use As Proxy
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect usage of the "unregmp2.exe" binary as a proxy to launch a custom version of "wmpnscfg.exe"

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\unregmp2\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "unregmp2\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/HideWMP.*"))
